qualitative.note: Fails Gate 1 (Understandability, REJECT). Operates primarily as an aggressive, leveraged corporate Bitcoin treasury and financial-engineering vehicle rather than an operating business compounder. Economic performance and balance sheet solvency are overwhelmingly governed by digital asset mark-to-market fluctuations, continuous dilutive capital market issuances (convertible debt and ATM equity), and crypto volatility, with legacy enterprise analytics software representing a secondary, low-growth sliver of total value.
qualitative.evidence: Holds over 850,000 BTC acquired for ~$64B+ via multi-billion-dollar convertible note offerings, preferred shares (STRC), and continuous ATM equity dilution. Core enterprise analytics software generates ~$500M in annual revenue (~$125M/quarter), which is economically insignificant relative to balance sheet digital asset exposure. 10-year historical operating ROIC median of ~4.5% reflects lack of standalone software compounding power. Under Gate 1 Reject Standard (b), crypto treasuries and financial-engineering holding vehicles fail circle of competence and verifiability standards.
